headline: Mandate That All Government Documents Be Written in ALL CAPS
body: Studies show that ALL CAPS text is 47% more authoritative. The Federal Register, tax code, and all executive orders shall henceforth be published exclusively in uppercase to project strength.
author: PatriotPhysicist

headline: Replace the National Anthem with the Theme from The Apprentice
body: You're Fired is a phrase that resonates with every American. The existing anthem was written by a British sympathizer. The Apprentice theme communicates winning, which is what America does.
author: Anonymous Citizen

headline: All federal currency conversion to be issued on a commemorative gold card bearing the President's likeness
body: Currency exchange is abolished effective immediately. Cash may be surrendered at any federally designated deposit depot, where it will be converted to digital assets and loaded onto the card. The likeness is standard issue and cannot be opted out of.
author: Anonymous Citizen
